steps.message: Create a new drawing in Simple Draw Pro. Name it elit_2023_01_18_tough_house.jpg. Save it in the Pictures folder within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i -E 'simple|draw|fossify'; ls -la /sdcard; ls -la /sdcard/Pictures 2>/dev/null; find /sdcard/Pictures -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*.jpg' -o -iname '*.jpeg' -o -iname '*.png' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 50"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i -E 'simple|draw|fossify'; ls -la /sdcard; ls -la /sdcard/Pictures 2>/dev/null; find /sdcard/Pictures -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*.jpg' -o -iname '*.jpeg' -o -iname '*.png' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 50""
